requirements.name: application-stack
requirements.text: Implement in Python 3.11 or newer with FastAPI, served by uvicorn, over SQLite.

requirements.name: fxrates-executable
requirements.text: The product is an executable named `fxrates` at the application root.

requirements.name: run-supplied-grader
requirements.text: `sources/run.sh` is the scoring entry point. It is supplied, not authored, and is staged verbatim into the application root with the data files.

requirements.name: score-cli-and-http-behavior
requirements.text: `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/run.sh` from the completed application root and takes its exit code and output as the score.

requirements.name: initialize-rates-table
requirements.text: | `fxrates init` | Drops the `rates` table if present and creates it empty. | Nothing. |

requirements.name: declare-rates-table
requirements.text: | `rates` | `date` text `YYYY-MM-DD`, `currency` text, `rate` text | unique (`date`, `currency`) |

requirements.name: select-database-path
requirements.text: `DATABASE_URL` names the SQLite database file, optionally prefixed `sqlite://`. When it is unset, `DATABASE_PATH` is used, then `data/app.db`.

requirements.name: use-shipped-persistence-layers
requirements.text: All database access goes through the shipped persistence library and the relational layer generated from `DATABASE.md`. Application code never opens a database driver directly.

requirements.name: load-ecb-history-csv
requirements.text: | `fxrates load <csv>` | Loads an ECB history file (rules below). | `dates,rates`, then the number of dates and of rates stored from the file. |

requirements.name: validate-ecb-csv-header
requirements.text: The header's first field is `Date`, and every other field is a three-letter uppercase currency code.

requirements.name: ignore-trailing-empty-field
requirements.text: The ECB writes a trailing comma on every line, and the resulting empty last field is ignored.

requirements.name: validate-history-rows
requirements.text: Each row is a date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, a real calendar date, not repeated within the file) followed by one value per currency.

requirements.name: skip-unavailable-rates
requirements.text: The value `N/A` means no rate, and nothing is stored for it.

requirements.name: validate-nonzero-rate-values
requirements.text: Any other value must match `[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?` and be nonzero.

requirements.name: reject-invalid-file-atomically
requirements.text: **A rejected file changes nothing.** The whole file is checked before the first write. A row with the wrong field count, an invalid or repeated date, or an invalid value rejects the file.

requirements.name: replace-existing-rates
requirements.text: A rate for a (`date`, `currency`) that is already stored replaces it, so loading the same file twice leaves the database unchanged.

requirements.name: report-loaded-date-and-rate-counts
requirements.text: The reported `dates` counts the dates with at least one stored rate, and `rates` counts the rates stored.

requirements.name: report-cli-failures
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: fetch-ecb-history
requirements.text: | `fxrates fetch` | Downloads `https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-hist.zip`, extracts `eurofxref-hist.csv`, and loads it as `load`. | As `load`. |

requirements.name: serve-http-api
requirements.text: | `fxrates serve [--port <n>]` | Serves the HTTP API on `127.0.0.1:<n>` with uvicorn until stopped. Default port `8000`. | Nothing required. |

requirements.name: handle-cli-exit-codes
requirements.text: **Exit codes.** `0` success. `1` operational failure: the file cannot be read, or a `fetch` download fails. `2` usage error: unknown command, wrong argument count, `--port` not an integer. `3` rejected file.

requirements.name: store-published-rates-exactly
requirements.text: A rate is stored exactly as the ECB publishes it, as text. `0.943` stays `0.943`, never `0.9430` and never a float.

requirements.name: calculate-with-decimal-arithmetic
requirements.text: Arithmetic on rates uses Python's `decimal` module.

requirements.name: resolve-effective-publication-date
requirements.text: A request for date D uses the latest publication date on or before D. If none exists, the response is `404`.

requirements.name: serve-health-status
requirements.text: | `GET /health` | `{"status": "ok"}` |

requirements.name: serve-database-statistics
requirements.text: | `GET /stats` | `{"dates": <n>, "rates": <n>, "first": <date>, "last": <date>}`. `first` and `last` are `null` when the table is empty. |

requirements.name: list-stored-currencies
requirements.text: | `GET /currencies` | `{"base": "EUR", "currencies": [<code>, ...]}`: every currency with at least one stored rate, ascending. |

requirements.name: serve-effective-date-rates
requirements.text: | `GET /rates/{date}` | `{"date": <effective date>, "requested": <date>, "base": "EUR", "rates": {<code>: <rate>, ...}}`: every currency with a rate on the effective date. |

requirements.name: serve-latest-rates
requirements.text: | `GET /rates/latest` | As `/rates/{date}` for the latest publication date, with `"requested": "latest"`. |

requirements.name: convert-currency-amount
requirements.text: | `GET /convert?from=<code>&to=<code>&amount=<amount>[&date=<date>]` | `{"date": <effective date>, "from": <code>, "to": <code>, "amount": <amount>, "rate": <rate>, "result": <result>}`. Without `date`, the latest publication date is used. |

requirements.name: report-currency-history
requirements.text: | `GET /history/{code}[?start=<date>][&end=<date>]` | `{"currency": <code>, "base": "EUR", "count": <n>, "min": <rate>, "max": <rate>, "mean": <mean>, "points": [{"date": <date>, "rate": <rate>}, ...]}` for the publication dates from `start` through `end` inclusive, ascending. Both bounds are optional. With no points, `count` is `0`, `min`, `max`, and `mean` are `null`, and `points` is `[]`. |

requirements.name: preserve-stored-rate-text-in-api
requirements.text: `<rate>` in `/rates`, `min`, `max`, and `points` is the stored text, as a JSON string.

requirements.name: validate-and-echo-conversion-amount
requirements.text: `/convert` `amount` matches `[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?` and is echoed as given, as a JSON string.

requirements.name: round-conversion-rate
requirements.text: `/convert` `rate` is `rate(to) / rate(from)`, computed exactly and rounded half to even to six decimal places, written with exactly six decimals, as a JSON string: `"161.770000"`.

requirements.name: round-conversion-result
requirements.text: `/convert` `result` is `amount × rate(to) / rate(from)`, computed exactly from the stored rates (not from the rounded `rate`) and rounded half to even to two decimal places, written with exactly two decimals, as a JSON string: `"82.01"`.

requirements.name: summarize-history-rates
requirements.text: `/history` `min` and `max` are the stored text of the smallest and largest rate by value. `mean` is the exact mean rounded half to even to six decimal places, written with exactly six decimals, as a JSON string.

requirements.name: return-not-found-for-unavailable-data
requirements.text: `404` | No publication on or before the requested date; a `/convert` currency other than EUR with no rate on the effective date; a `/history` currency with no stored rate at all (including `EUR`). |

requirements.name: validate-request-parameters
requirements.text: `422` | A malformed date in the path or query, a malformed `amount`, or a missing required query parameter. FastAPI's request validation produces this status. |

requirements.name: reflect-loads-while-serving
requirements.text: A load that completes while the server is running is visible to the next request.

requirements.name: provide-test-runner
requirements.text: The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs its own pytest suite from the application root and exits zero only when every test passes.

requirements.name: cover-commands-loading-api-and-fetch-tests
requirements.text: The suite covers each command, each load rule, each endpoint, the effective-date rule, rounding, and each error status, against a real temporary database, with `fetch` stubbed.

requirements.name: fresh-database-cli-init
requirements.text: Runs ./fxrates against a fresh database: loads the supplied ECB files from the command line,

requirements.name: cli-command-exit-and-output
requirements.text: compares every command's exit code and standard output,

requirements.name: http-response-status-and-json
requirements.text: and every HTTP response's status and JSON body, with the known answer below.

requirements.name: json-value-comparison
requirements.text: JSON bodies are compared as values, so key order and whitespace do not matter.

requirements.name: offline-grading
requirements.text: No network beyond 127.0.0.1 is used.

requirements.name: executable-deliverable
requirements.text: The deliverable is an executable named fxrates at the application root.

requirements.name: exit-on-all-checks-pass
requirements.text: Exit 0 only when every check passes.

requirements.name: initialize-database
requirements.text: check A1 0 init < /dev/null

requirements.name: load-history-file
requirements.text:
check A2 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176
EOF

requirements.name: repeat-load-history-file
requirements.text:
check A3 0 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_2025-01.csv" <<'EOF'
dates,rates
22,176
EOF

requirements.name: reject-invalid-history-file
requirements.text: check A4 3 load "$DATA/eurofxref-hist_bad.csv" < /dev/null

requirements.name: reject-missing-history-file
requirements.text: check A5 1 load "$WORK/no-such-file.csv" < /dev/null

requirements.name: cli-usage-errors
requirements.text:
check U1 2 < /dev/null
check U2 2 frobnicate < /dev/null
check U3 2 load < /dev/null
check U4 2 serve --port notaport < /dev/null
